question: In a certain code language, 'DRAWING' is written as 'CQZVHMF' and 'TURQUOISE' is written as ' STQPTNHRD', how will 'COLOR' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- Immediate previous letter order according to English alphabetic series is written.

​So,

 
• 'DRAWING' is written as 'CQZVHMF'

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51e60d95b354dc20aeb40cc661f1b31d33b4cccc7bbb1fe82f334c0607477561.png] 

And,

 
• 'TURQUOISE' is written as ' STQPTNHRD'

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e85b26300d463bf6efd6550364aff5f6d8adf004481f16090451535725fff57c.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'COLOR' is written as 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa0e07dccde69d0f660663a61ae75ec0ff9c7e733daf015c35212c9aaa72703e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**BNKNQ**".
